about.en: Circle Internet Group bStock (CRCLB) is a tokenized share of Circle Internet Group, Inc. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x80f3d493ebce97e343c53d29a137942416b4ffc0, backed 1:1 by CRCL shares held in segregated custody. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership of the shares.
